name: Kit PVP! [Season 1!]
desc:
🚨 NOT APPROVED BY, ENDORSED BY, OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT. 🚨

Hits, attack cooldown, crits, knockback, armor and enchantments all work like the real game. Netherite gives the right amount of protection, and pearls, fire and fall damage deal exactly what they should.

🗡️ 6 kits: Sword, Axe, Mace, Crystal, NethPot and SMP.

🏆 Ranked and Casual: play 1v1, or 2v2 and 3v3 with your party. Win to climb from Coal to Netherite rank.

🤖 Bot practice: Easy, Normal and Hard bots for every kit. They crit, W-tap, pop totems and crystal just like players do.

🗺️ 15 arenas: Colosseum, ether, The Tend, Castle, Desert Temple, Lighthouse, Deepslate Mines and more.

🏠 Full lobby: walk up to an NPC to queue or practice, jump into Free For All, and check the Wins and Rating leaderboards.

✨ Every duel opens with a VS intro and a flyover of the map, and you can rematch in one click. Your stats save between sessions. Works on PC, mobile and controller.

GG, and good luck! 🔥
